brief: `isWindy()` (~842) moves washing, smoke, leaves, tree sway and the morning ticker line — all west of the bridge. The fountain (`drawFountain` ~4404) sprays five symmetric jets in a gale. Make the plaza read a windy day: the jets lean and their droplets carry downwind (there is a `windT`/`sway` already at ~3815 to phase off), the lee side of the basin gets a visible drift of spray, and `fountainStand()` (the share willing to stand at it, read by both spawners) drops on windy days so people take the benches instead of the wet side. If budget allows, the bandstand bunting (`bandF`) flutters on the same days.
successLooksLike: Two shots at the same pinned instant, one windy day and one calm (pick days by hash(day,99)): the windy plume visibly leans one way and the calm one is symmetric. fountain-year.mjs still passes at the anchor. Over ten windy days, standers at the fountain are measurably fewer than on ten calm days, with the bench share up by the same amount (the east's arrivals are unchanged).
avoid: No new R() draws in the renderer — lean and drift are hash()+clock. Do not change eastCap/eastRate; move the SPLIT, not the arrivals. Do not touch the river streaks (they drift on riverRun and that is the river's job).
